edit.description: `SliceWindow` gains the two `TickFacts` fields; the comment saying a handoff-built window omits them goes with them
the window carries `pendingAfter`/`priorAttempts`; `refusedForPlan` and `wakeSet`'s `refused && slice.name === INBOX_PHASE` arm both go
the wake set over a standing refusal, from a non-build phase too

summary: Two readers classify one standing refusal; widen `SliceWindow` so `inbox.live` is the only one

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

acceptance: `inboxWindow.live`'s standing-refusal leg is live on the handoff path, and the wake set names no slice by name
tests: a standing refusal left by a plan tick puts the inbox slice in the wake set
notes: Per note THE-HANDOFF-READS-THE-RECORD-SET-THE-ENGINE-HOLDS: the result now carries `pendingAfter` + `priorAttempts`, so the compensating arm has a reader that can answer for itself. Dropping it also drops the `BUILD_PHASE` guard, which was right when the evidence was a wave's own fates and is arbitrary now that a standing record outlives the tick.
